profiles.name: Saanich
profiles.label: Saanich garden-suite comparisons
profiles.scope: Preliminary lot area, defined width, floor area and landscaped-share comparisons for a new Saanich garden suite with an existing single-family dwelling.

inputs.label: Lot area

definition.label: Lot area
definition.basis: area of the lot under Saanich Zoning Bylaw definitions; parcel/strata geometry requires review
definition.description: One of five cumulative garden-suite eligibility conditions in §5.35(b).

currentness_limitations: Manually captured September 25, 2026; effective amendment chain remains unresolved.
Provisional comparisons use the retained source excerpts and stated assumptions.

inputs.help: One of five cumulative garden-suite eligibility conditions in §5.35(b).

inputs.label: Lot width

definition.label: Lot width
definition.basis: Lot Width as defined in Zoning Bylaw 8200 §2, not bounding-box width
definition.description: The bylaw definition of Lot Width uses a perpendicular line to the line joining front/rear midpoints; a GIS envelope width is not equivalent.

currentness_limitations: Manually captured September 25, 2026; effective amendment chain remains unresolved.
Provisional comparisons use the retained source excerpts and stated assumptions.

inputs.help: The bylaw definition of Lot Width uses a perpendicular line to the line joining front/rear midpoints; a GIS envelope width is not equivalent.

inputs.label: Garden-suite floor area

definition.label: Garden-suite floor area
definition.basis: Gross Floor Area (R) per Zoning Bylaw 8200 §2, measured to exterior wall faces with stated exclusions
definition.description: Gross Floor Area (R) is defined in §2 with inclusions and exclusions; manufacturer floor area is not this value.

currentness_limitations: Manually captured September 25, 2026; effective amendment chain remains unresolved.
Provisional comparisons use the retained source excerpts and stated assumptions.

inputs.help: Gross Floor Area (R) is defined in §2 with inclusions and exclusions; manufacturer floor area is not this value.

inputs.label: Landscaped share of lot

definition.label: Landscaped share of lot
definition.basis: Open Site Space Requirement (GS) landscaped area divided by total lot area under §2
definition.description: §2 excludes buildings, structures, driveways and impervious surfaces from the landscaped numerator, with an above-ground projection exception.

currentness_limitations: Manually captured September 25, 2026; effective amendment chain remains unresolved.
Provisional comparisons use the retained source excerpts and stated assumptions.

inputs.help: §2 excludes buildings, structures, driveways and impervious surfaces from the landscaped numerator, with an above-ground projection exception.

inputs.label: Does the property's zone permit a garden suite?
inputs.help: Check the applicable zone schedule in Bylaw 8200. Automatic Saanich zoning lookup is not available in this assessment.

inputs.label: Inside the Urban Containment Boundary?
inputs.help: Either this boundary or the Sewer Service Area can meet the location condition in §5.35(b)(ii).
